title: Consistent Conversational State for Virtual Agents: Slot-Based Memory for Accurate Fact Retrieval
mechanism: At write time, classify each new fact into a typed (entity, attribute) slot and enforce single-current-value-per-slot by overwriting/superseding prior fill instead of appending a new memory row alongside it; retrieval then reads slot state directly rather than re-ranking multiple candidate facts.

expected_gain.rationale: chitta already has triplet_supersede for versioned (s,r,o) overwrite and detect_contradictions/resolve_contradiction for post-hoc cleanup, but nothing forces write-time slot uniqueness before contradictory value_facts are stored, so retrieval can still surface stale/conflicting facts the RRF merge doesn't resolve; enforcing slot schema at ingest is a smaller structural add on top of existing machinery, not a new capability.

cost.scope: chitta-field distill/store write path (value_facts + triplet ingestion), field_distill.cpp dedup logic, contradiction detection hooks

evidence.claim: Citation check 2026-09-16: the DOI registry and IVA 2026 accepted-poster list confirm the title and authors Erica Butts and Salam Daher. The title concerns slot-based memory and accurate fact retrieval; publisher body and abstract were not retrieved, so methods and results remain unverified.
